category_edits.rationale: Test stronger recency by shortening the causal pooling half-life from three interactions to two across all four datasets. Retain the 0.8 GRU-state plus 0.2 causal-mean readout, padding exclusion, final-real-position inference, and all other model and training settings. Synchronize training metadata and the embedded predictor check.

change_summary: Shorten causal interest pooling half-life from three interactions to two and synchronize predictor metadata. Preserve one GRU4Rec checkpoint per category.
